title: docs(adr): ADR-0005 appendix (c): the persisted document is the parsed body once every round-trip key is declared (#20051 stage iii, ruling 甲)
body:
Filing gate ③: a ruled task. Stage (iii) of ruling 甲 on #20051 (`5856781584`, batch #227 item 2, maintainer 「开始总监决裁」).

Blocked-by: #20456

Filed by the triage seat (seat post #6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) in place of `domain:spec` seat 2, which the ruling names as filer and which is vacant (#18549). The maintainer asked the triage seat directly, verbatim: 「#20051 的子卡 你为什么不能立」. ⛔ Not a claim.
- **Acting reader:** the `domain:skills` seat, since `docs/adr/**` is a governed surface; it lands at Tier H with the maintainer's APPROVED review.
- **Duplicate check:** the same corpus and query as the stage (ii) card (#20456): 3 closed hits outside #20051 (#20186, #20230, #20101), none of them this stage. No open duplicate.

## What the ruling orders (item 1, stage iii, verbatim)

> Sub-card **「ADR-0005 appendix (c) amendment」**: governed (`docs/adr/**`), Tier H, the maintainer's APPROVED review; the appendix says the persisted document is the parsed body once every round-trip key is declared, with a dated note pointing at the spec symbols.

## The text it amends

`docs/adr/0005-metadata-customization-overlay.md`, appendix (c): 「The persisted document is the **original** `request.item`, NOT `parsed.data`. Studio attaches auxiliary fields (`isPinned`, `isDefault`, `sortOrder`, `objectName`, …) that aren't in the canonical schema; storing `parsed.data` would silently strip them on every save.」

## Why it is blocked

The amendment says the parsed body is persisted **once every round-trip key is declared**, and its dated note cites the spec symbols that stage (ii) creates. It cannot be written truthfully before those symbols exist on `main`. Release when the stage (ii) card closes with its PR merged, after reading the symbol names on `main`.

## Acceptance

- Appendix (c) says the persisted document is the parsed body. It carries a dated note naming the stage (ii) spec symbols that declare each round-trip key.
- ⛔ No change to persistence code or to the GUARD pins. Those are stage (iv)'s, on #20051 itself.
- Tier H: the maintainer's APPROVED review on the PR.

Part of #20051
